title: Kissed Smoky Uruguayan Beef Bowl
description: A hearty Uruguayan dish featuring smoky beef, served in an earthenware bowl, perfect for a solo dinner
instructions: Heat the smoky olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add the beef strips and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness
Transfer the beef to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm
Reduce heat to medium and add the minced garlic to the skillet, cooking for 1 minute
Stir in the chopped parsley and cilantro, cooking for an additional minute
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the herb mixture and stir to combine
Add the red pepper flakes and salt-free seasoning blend to the skillet and stir to combine
To assemble the bowls, slice the cooked beef into thin strips and place on top of the herb mixture in the earthenware bowl
